raw_text_content: Villaggio Grille - Italian Fusion & Seafood Restaurant in Orange Beach, AL. Italian fusion has never tasted so good! Our talented chefs and pristine ingredients create a dining experience so enjoyable you won't want it to end. Contact: 251.224.6510, villaggiogrilleob@gmail.com, 4790 Main Street Suite F 108-B, Orange Beach, AL 36561. Hours: Sunday-Wednesday 11am-9pm, Thursday-Saturday 11am-10pm. Menus include Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, Happy Hour, Drink Menu, Family Meals. Family Meals feed 4 people and include salad and house made focaccia: 10 Layer Lasagna $42, Shrimp or Chicken Alfredo $42, Grilled Salmon $56. Takeout and delivery available via Time to Eat the Beach and DoorDash. Reservations available through Yelp. Wine pairings and catering available. Featured review from Alex Whitaker praising Oyster Trio and Seafood Pasta for perfect cooking and flavor. Sister restaurants: Ginny Lane Bar Grill, Yoho Rum and Tacos, Mile Marker 158 Dockside.
